questions.chapter: Energy Resources, Renewable Technologies & Energy Conservation
questions.text: Explain energy scenario and resources of Nepal. Compare Renewable Energy sources (Hydropower, Solar Photovoltaic, Wind, Biomass/Biogas) with Fossil Fuels. Explain Energy Audit and Demand Side Management (DSM) techniques for industrial and commercial facilities.

questions.chapter: Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA & IEE) & Pollution Control
questions.text: Explain Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) and Initial Environmental Examination (IEE) according to Environment Protection Act of Nepal. Describe the EIA process steps: Screening, Scoping, Baseline Data Collection, Impact Identification (Matrix and Network methods), Mitigation Measures, and Environmental Management Plan (EMP).

questions.chapter: Climate Change, Carbon Trading & Sustainable Development Goals (SDG)
questions.text: Explain Climate Change causes (Greenhouse Gases - GHG emission), global warming potential, and impacts on Himalayan glaciers and water resources. Explain the Kyoto Protocol, Paris Agreement, Carbon Trading, Clean Development Mechanism (CDM), and UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

questions.chapter: Social Engineering, Community Participation & Gender Equality
questions.text: What is Social Engineering in infrastructure development? Explain Social Impact Assessment (SIA), Resettlement and Rehabilitation (R&R) policy, Public Hearing, Free Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC), and Gender Equality and Social Inclusion (GESI) mainstreaming in engineering projects.

questions.chapter: Engineering Ethics, Professional Liability & Nepal Engineering Council (NEC)
questions.text: Explain the Code of Ethics for Engineers according to the Nepal Engineering Council (NEC) Act. Discuss Professional Liability, Conflict of Interest, Whistleblowing, Bribery/Corruption in public procurement, and Safety, Health, and Welfare of the public.
